  "cons": [
    "Lacked robust CRM or project management features for core tasks",
    "Reporting capabilities were not granular enough for specific needs",
    "Initial customization for specific workflows was somewhat complex"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The Tech Director found Zoho Desk to be a user-friendly and cost-effective solution primarily for help desk operations. While it excelled at managing support tickets and offered useful automation, its core functionality did not fully align with the broader requirements of managing leads, projects, and legal details, which were central to their role. This led to a somewhat mixed experience, despite appreciating its value and ease of use for its intended purpose."

json.overall_experience: The Tech Director found Zoho Desk to be a user-friendly and cost-effective solution primarily for help desk operations. While it excelled at managing support tickets and offered useful automation, its core functionality did not fully align with the broader requirements of managing leads, projects, and legal details, which were central to their role. This led to a somewhat mixed experience, despite appreciating its value and ease of use for its intended purpose.
